g.text: Option Desk - Forward paper testing and ledger states
time, source plan and optional thesis.
Last-trade marks carry a quality note.
A missing quote is not zero.
It is not an early-close fill or a general two-expiry mark.
Expiry and quote freshness are not enforced by the command.
close with ID and settlement price
Sources: shell cli/forward.py and engine backtest/forward.py. Paper results are not executions.
